01

About

I lead the Online Brand Shop P&L for LG Electronics India, owning revenue, margin and the demand engine across TV, Audio and IT / Monitor categories. My work sits where brand meets performance: I care as much about the story a customer sees as the unit economics behind the sale.

Over twenty years I've moved from field sales at Dr. Reddy's, through national brand-building at Amway, into regional marketing and now digital commerce leadership at LG. The constant is a bias for measurable outcomes. I treat a P&L the way I treat a race: split by split, improving what's improvable and protecting what's working.

I'm now looking to take that operating discipline into a broader Head of Marketing, Digital Commerce or CMO-track mandate.

Projects & Case Studies

Selected work, framed as challenge, approach and outcome. Figures are directional.

Digital Commerce · P&L

Turning the Brand Shop into a profit engine

Challenge

The online brand store was a showcase, not a P&L. Traffic without durable, margin-positive revenue.

Approach

Category-led merchandising across TV / Audio / IT, funnel ownership end-to-end, and hard margin discipline on promotions.

25% CAGR with margin 8→15%
Performance Marketing

A dual-engine demand model

Challenge

Balance lead-generation efficiency with direct D2C scale, without one cannibalising the other.

Approach

Lead-gen feeding assisted tele-conversion, run alongside a direct-purchase D2C engine, tied together by unified measurement.

7.06× D2C ROAS · 2.35× blended
